task_title: AUG-173: the AUG-130 gate-mode case is hermetic to a docs-only HEAD
task_criteria: The AUG-130 probe forces the full gate so a docs-only HEAD cannot take the doc-only fast path. PROOF: `grep -c "AUGER_GATE_INNER=1 GATE_FULL=1" tests/test_gate_mode.sh` prints 1. FAILIF: that count is 0 or greater than 1.

The gate-mode case passes at this head and prints its own verdict line. PROOF: `bash tests/test_gate_mode.sh` exits 0 and its output contains "AUG-130 skipped-arm policy: PASS". FAILIF: a non-zero exit, or that line absent from the output.

GATE_FULL is still the documented override that defeats the doc-only shortcut, and the shortcut still exists. PROOF: `grep -c "GATE_FULL" tests/gate.sh` prints 2 and `grep -c "doc-only fast path" tests/gate.sh` prints 5. FAILIF: either count drops, meaning the override was removed or the fast path deleted instead of bypassed.

No weakening of the AUG-130 skipped-arm policy. PROOF: `grep -c "env -u AUGER_ALLOW_SKIPPED_ARMS" tests/test_gate_mode.sh` prints 1, `grep -c "GATE PASS (DEGRADED)" tests/test_gate_mode.sh` prints 1, and `git diff c461056..HEAD -- tests/gate.sh` prints nothing. FAILIF: the strict leg sets the escape, the DEGRADED assertion disappears, or tests/gate.sh changed in this branch.

The red-to-green delta is committed as evidence, not asserted in prose. PROOF: `grep -c "AUG-130: gate exited 0" evidence/AUG-173/01-prefix-red-docsonly.txt` prints 1, `grep -c "AUG-130 skipped-arm policy: PASS" evidence/AUG-173/02-postfix-green-docsonly.txt` prints 1, and `grep -c "rc=1" evidence/AUG-173/04-nonvacuity.txt` prints 1. FAILIF: any of the three greps prints 0.

items.criterion: The AUG-130 probe forces the full gate so a docs-only HEAD cannot take the doc-only fast path. PROOF: `grep -c "AUGER_GATE_INNER=1 GATE_FULL=1" tests/test_gate_mode.sh` prints 1. FAILIF: that count is 0 or greater than 1.
items.detail: `grep -c "AUGER_GATE_INNER=1 GATE_FULL=1" tests/test_gate_mode.sh` -> 1 (tests/test_gate_mode.sh:423, inside run_inner_gate()). Independently proven load-bearing, not just present: on a fresh detached worktree at docs-only commit c461056 (git diff --name-only HEAD~1 HEAD -> docs/qa/aug172-fix-proof.md), the fixed file exits 0 with 'AUG-130 skipped-arm policy: PASS'; stripping GATE_FULL=1 from line 423 makes the same tree exit 1 with 'AUG-130: gate exited 0 with its pytest arm NOT run:' and '== gate mode: DOC-ONLY fast path (skipping pytest + e2e smoke) =='. The override is what defeats the shortcut.

items.criterion: The gate-mode case passes at this head and prints its own verdict line. PROOF: `bash tests/test_gate_mode.sh` exits 0 and its output contains "AUG-130 skipped-arm policy: PASS". FAILIF: a non-zero exit, or that line absent from the output.
items.detail: `bash tests/test_gate_mode.sh` -> EXIT=0; output line 4 is 'AUG-130 skipped-arm policy: PASS' (tail: 'gate prerequisite preflight: PASS / AUG-116: zombie pid 2086627 classified dead / AUG-081 wrapper regression: PASS / AUG-130 skipped-arm policy: PASS'). Also reproduced green on a fresh detached worktree at docs-only c461056 with the fixed file: EXIT=0, same verdict line.

items.criterion: GATE_FULL is still the documented override that defeats the doc-only shortcut, and the shortcut still exists. PROOF: `grep -c "GATE_FULL" tests/gate.sh` prints 2 and `grep -c "doc-only fast path" tests/gate.sh` prints 5. FAILIF: either count drops, meaning the override was removed or the fast path deleted instead of bypassed.
items.detail: `grep -c "GATE_FULL" tests/gate.sh` -> 2 (tests/gate.sh:77 comment 'Override: GATE_FULL=1 forces the full gate regardless of diff', tests/gate.sh:79 `if [ "${GATE_FULL:-0}" != "1" ]`). `grep -c "doc-only fast path" tests/gate.sh` -> 5 (lines 74, 122, 238, 273, 291). The shortcut is intact and bypassed, not deleted: DOC_ONLY detection at gate.sh:78-95, and the two skip sites at gate.sh:237-238 (pytest) and gate.sh:272-273 (e2e-smoke) still exist.

items.criterion: No weakening of the AUG-130 skipped-arm policy. PROOF: `grep -c "env -u AUGER_ALLOW_SKIPPED_ARMS" tests/test_gate_mode.sh` prints 1, `grep -c "GATE PASS (DEGRADED)" tests/test_gate_mode.sh` prints 1, and `git diff c461056..HEAD -- tests/gate.sh` prints nothing. FAILIF: the strict leg sets the escape, the DEGRADED assertion disappears, or tests/gate.sh changed in this branch.
items.detail: `grep -c "env -u AUGER_ALLOW_SKIPPED_ARMS" tests/test_gate_mode.sh` -> 1 (line 423, the strict leg still unsets the escape); `grep -c "GATE PASS (DEGRADED)" tests/test_gate_mode.sh` -> 1 (line 461, assertion intact); `git diff c461056..HEAD -- tests/gate.sh` printed nothing (empty output). The DEGRADED leg is still genuine rather than vacuous: with GATE_FULL=1, DOC_ONLY=0, so the pytest arm reaches the `import pytest` probe at gate.sh:240 and skips as a REQUIRED arm, which is exactly what gate.sh:396-398 ('GATE PASS (DEGRADED)' / 'required arms NOT run: pytest' / 'NOT proof the suite ran') asserts.

items.criterion: The red-to-green delta is committed as evidence, not asserted in prose. PROOF: `grep -c "AUG-130: gate exited 0" evidence/AUG-173/01-prefix-red-docsonly.txt` prints 1, `grep -c "AUG-130 skipped-arm policy: PASS" evidence/AUG-173/02-postfix-green-docsonly.txt` prints 1, and `grep -c "rc=1" evidence/AUG-173/04-nonvacuity.txt` prints 1. FAILIF: any of the three greps prints 0.
items.detail: All three greps -> 1 each. The files are committed, not untracked: `git ls-tree -r --name-only HEAD -- evidence/AUG-173/` lists 01-prefix-red-docsonly.txt, 02-postfix-green-docsonly.txt, 03-postfix-green-worktree.txt, 04-nonvacuity.txt, NOTES.md, all added in c46514e (git show --stat: 6 files changed, 119 insertions). The recorded transcripts are reproducible: I re-ran the non-vacuity mutation (sed 'GATE FAIL: required arms did not run' -> 'GATE FAIL: arms did not run (MUTATED)') on a c461056 worktree and got EXIT=1 with 'expected output to contain GATE\ FAIL:\ arms\ did\ not\ run\ \(MUTATED\)', matching 04-nonvacuity.txt.

items.criterion: The GATE_FULL=1 addition is scoped to the AUG-130 probe and does not leak into other legs or make the DEGRADED assertion vacuous.
items.detail: `grep -n "GATE_FULL" tests/test_gate_mode.sh` -> only line 87 (pre-existing preflight probe, unchanged) and line 423 (the new one, inside run_inner_gate()). Both AUG-130 call sites (line 435 strict, line 452 degraded) route through run_inner_gate, so the change is confined to the two legs it is meant to fix. The DEGRADED leg still exercises the required-skip path: the mutation run printed '== gate mode: FULL gate ==', proving GATE_FULL=1 takes effect and DOC_ONLY=0, so the pytest skip at gate.sh:240 is a required-arm skip rather than a doc-only skip.
